content: Blocked by L2 (skeleton), L3 (IPC mechanism and sub-decisions), L4 (type checker must pass before writing types). Scope — Python Protocol/Pydantic types with full docstrings, no implementations: Source (resolve/fetch/normalize → RawDocument), RawDocument (the membrane payload — Pydantic model, shape informed by IPC decision in L3 and DESIGN.md §9.3: provenance block, dedup anchors, content-type-tagged blocks array), Enricher (declares applicable content_types, produces enrichment data). All types fully annotated, no implicit Any, no TODOs. The RawDocument Pydantic model is the Python-canonical side of the membrane; its shape is the source of truth that L8 will generate fixtures from. AC: all three types import cleanly from alcanzai-ingestion and alcanzai-understanding; type checker passes in strict mode; ruff passes; pytest runs (0 tests ok); no stubs or TODOs. Not salvage — fresh against the contract.
